title: Runway multiband: headcount trigger mapper and price-sensitivity lab
content:
Purpose:
Capture a compact, operationalizable map that ties multi-band runway buckets to discrete headcount actions and pricing levers (soft increases, slab gating, SKU reweights). This is intended as the canonical finance -> People Ops -> Pricing playbook for 1H run-rate stress events.

Executive summary (one-paragraph):
We propose a three-tiered trigger framework (Guard, Caution, Emergency) with discrete headcount actions and graduated pricing responses mapped to token-price sensitivity ranges and observed usage deltas. The goal: keep net runway > 9 months in the baseline stress case and > 6 months in a double-shock while preserving critical engineering velocity for Dedicated/Private launches. This sheet shows the trigger bands, assumed elasticities, projected burn impact, and step-by-step operational tasks.

Top-line assumptions (inputs):
- Current monthly burn (cash opex + payroll): $2,150,000
- Starting headcount: 150 FTE (avg fully-loaded monthly comp = $12,000)
- Growth baseline (tokens/month): +8% m/m; stress shock scenario: demand -30% or +40% depending on macro; pricing elasticity baseline: -0.6 (i.e., 1% price rise => 0.6% drop in volume)
- Token unit economics: avg revenue per token (hosted) = $0.0009, marginal cost per token (GPU+infra+ops) = $0.00045
- Target runway buckets: Green >= 18 months; Yellow 9-18 months; Orange 6-9 months; Red < 6 months

Runway bucket mapping (operational table):
Band | Runway months | Immediate HC action | Payroll delta (monthly) | Pricing levers | Expected runway effect (months)
Green | >=18 | No action; monitor | 0 | N/A | +0
Yellow | 9-18 | Freeze open reqs (non-customer facing) + defer 2 contractors | -$120,000 | Introduce slab gating on lowest-margin SKUs; 5% price uplift on low-commit tiers | +1.5
Orange | 6-9 | Pause hiring + 6 FTE voluntary hiring freeze conversion (contractor swap) + pause noncritical infra projects | -$360,000 | 10% price uplift on on-demand; soft quota gating for new free-tier signups | +2.3
Red | <6 | Targeted reductions 8-12 FTE (roles by priority matrix) + suspend growth product experiments | -$960,000 | Hard SKU repricing + 15% price uplift + urgent enterprise sales push (contract credits) | +4.8

Notes on actions:
- "Freeze open reqs" means backfill only for critical SRE/security/customer-impact roles (must be approved by CFO + head of Eng).
- Contractor conversions: convert 4 contractors to lower-cost part-time (saves ~$40k/mo) and defer 2 renewals.
- Priority matrix for Red reductions is appended in the appendix (engineering infrastructure non-customer facing, growth marketing, discretionary vendor spend).

Pricing sensitivity experiments (lab):
We model a staircase pricing change and the implied token volume response, then compute net revenue and runway delta. Representative sample: baseline monthly tokens = 450B (hosted+dedicated mix).
- +5% price: volume change = -3% (elasticity -0.6) -> net revenue change = +~1.9% -> runway +0.3 months
- +10% price: volume change = -6% -> net revenue change = +~3.4% -> runway +0.6 months
- +15% price: volume change = -9% -> net revenue change = +~4.6% -> runway +1.0 months
Sensitivity caveats: adoption friction on Dedicated deals may be asymmetric; enterprise customers have contractual constraints so realize <60% of modeled elasticity.

Headcount phasing and people ops playbook (timeline view):
- Week 0-2 (Yellow triggers): immediate req freeze note; run skill reassignments; customer-success to absorb highest priority churn risk accounts (CS lead).
- Week 3-6 (Orange triggers): implement hiring pause org-wide; reassign 6 FTE (from growth & IRL experiments) to ops backlog; start voluntary separation package prep (legal + people ops).
- Week 6-12 (Red triggers): finalize headcount reductions & contractors unwind; update external hiring freeze communications; execute retention bonuses for top 12 engine/infra contributors to avoid product regressions (funding from discretionary spend cuts).

Detailed sensitivity matrix (quick extract):
- Scenario A (demand drop -30%, no price change) -> burn remains $2.1M but revenue down 22% -> runway -4.5 months -> hits Orange
- Scenario B (demand drop -30%, +10% price) -> demand drop net -34% (additive elasticity) -> revenue down 30% -> runway -6.2 months -> borderline Red
- Scenario C (demand rise +40%, no price change) -> revenue up 28% but variable cost rises faster -> net burn +$350k -> runway -1.2 months (moves toward Yellow)

Operational KPIs to monitor (daily/weekly cadence):
- Daily: token throughput, spot GPU utilization, top-20 customers % of tokens
- Weekly: net revenue M/M, churn by cohort, average tokens per active dev account
- Monthly: runway months, headcount FTE count, contractor spend, pricing acceptance rate by SKU

Governance & decision path: who signs each action
- Req freeze: CFO + People Ops lead (auto after Yellow is detected for 2 consecutive weeks)
- Pricing uplift pilot (<=10%): Pricing PM + CRO signoff; legal to verify T&Cs for enterprise customers
- Large layoffs (>5% of org): CEO + CFO + Head of People Ops; require 2-week review and exec communication plan

Appendix (quick lists):
- Low-harm reductions (first wave): growth experiments, discretionary consulting, travel & events, non-critical vendor licenses
- High-risk (avoid unless Red): infra reliability engineers, SRE on-call reductions, key eng leads on roadmap items for Dedicated/Private
- Communication templates: Slack+All-hands script + customer e-mail templates (drafts exist in linked artifacts)

Open questions & items for follow-up (placeholder):
1) Confirm elasticity by SKU with Product Pricing (linear vs. step functions for slabs) -> action: Pricing PM (Priya) to deliver per-SKU elasticity estimates by 2025-11-01.
2) Validate contractor conversion legal costs -> action: Legal (Diego) to confirm typical sever/sidecar cost by 2025-11-05.
3) Run a 10% price pilot on non-enterprise test cohort (5% of hosted tokens) for 4 weeks and measure acceptance + churn -> action: Growth + Billing engineering to schedule.

Quick action checklist (first 14 days):
- [ ] Publish req freeze memo and update hiring dashboard (owner: People Ops)
- [ ] Launch pricing pilot cohort (owner: Pricing PM)
- [ ] Run run-rate sensitivity Monte Carlo with 1,000 draws (owner: FP&A) and publish 50/10/1 percentile outcomes to execs
- [ ] Prepare customer comms templates for enterprise account managers (owner: CS lead)

Last notes (tone + guidance):
This is intentionally prescriptive and operational — not intended as an irrevocable headcount decision document. Use it to accelerate time-to-decision in an incoming shock. Respect people-first language and prioritize redeployment when possible.

Document history:
- 2025-10-12: created by Anika Shah (initial draft)
- 2025-11-02: scenario matrix updated after FP&A model pass (E. Park)
- 2026-02-03: added governance sign-off flow + pricing pilot note (Priya N.)
